**v1.14.5: the bot reads your cards, backpack and decks from the game's memory again after Wizard101's November patch, and picks the right picture size when it starts while the game is minimized.**

- **Fixed: "the cards can't be read in this build" since Wizard101's patch (game build 6AFBB954-37B4000, around 2026-11-18).**
  - **What was wrong:** the bot finds the game's classes by their names in the game's code. After the patch, the name the card reader needs ("CombatPlanningPhaseWindow") sits right after two other bytes instead of on its own, and the bot skipped it. From then on, every start failed to build the card reader (vision\vision.log said so; debug.log didn't). Your hand, your pips, the backpack, the decks, the gear and the game's UI size couldn't be read from memory. In battles the bot fell back to finding cards by their pictures.
  - **Now:** when a name isn't found on its own, the bot also accepts a copy that the game's code really loads. Every class it found before is found exactly as before.
- **Fixed: the wrong picture size after starting the bot while a full-screen Wizard101 is minimized.**
  - **What was wrong:** a full-screen game minimizes whenever another window takes the focus. Its minimized window read as 160x28, so the bot chose its pictures for that size: UI scale 1 instead of 0.856 on a 1920x1080 screen. Out of a battle nothing switched it back, because the 0.856 spellbook picture is too faint to pick a size by. Seen on 2026-11-20: 10 minutes without the spellbook seen once.
  - **Now:** a minimized game keeps the last size the bot measured. When the window comes back at a size it was played at before (generated\scales.txt), the bot uses that size's pictures, as it does at the start.
- **Checked:** against the running game (reading only): the card reader builds again and every other class reads as before. Two new test files, both failing on the old code. The five release scripts load. 864 of 903 vision tests pass (38 are skipped on this PC). `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. A review (three reviewers, two skeptics for each finding) confirmed one flaw in the picture-size fix, which is fixed, and two more skeptics found nothing in the revision. Not tried in a battle yet.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
